facility.name: Caring Hand Learning Center
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Accredited,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips,Night Care

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Non_Exact match: 260 COMMERICAL DR, HARKER HEIGHTS, TX, 76548

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: During the investigation inspection, a caregiver was observed out of ratio. They had 6 kids with a specified age group of 12-17 months which only allows them to have 5 children. This was corrected when another caregiver stepped into the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children: During the follow up inspection, there were 2 caregivers with 37 children on the playground, exceeding maxium group size.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1609)

occurrences.finding: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions: A caregiver was observed to be in a classroom by them self, not following the conditions placed on their background check. This was corrected when the caregiver was put in a room with another eligible caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions (26 TAC §745.635(3))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Three caregivers were observed walking out of their classroom, leaving their group of children unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: One caregiver did not know how many children they had in their classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: One caregiver stepped out of the classroom, leaving the classroom out of ratio.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Infants sleep in Designated Crib, Cot, Bed, or Mat: During a monitoring inspection, a 6-month-old infant was observed to be asleep on the floor. This was corrected when the caregiver picked the infant up and put them in their crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infants sleep in Designated Crib, Cot, Bed, or Mat (26 TAC §746.2424)

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible: During a monitoring inspection, a 6-month-old infant was observed sleeping in a restrictive device. This was corrected when the caregiver removed the child from the device and place them in their crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Two children were missing health statements from a healthcare professional.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out: During an inspection, a child was observed placed in a stroller, strapped in, as a way of guidance so they would not run off. This was corrected when the caregiver removed the child from the stroller.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out (26 TAC §746.2805(8))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: After reviewing staff files, 6 staff were missing the 2985 affidavit, 4 were missing copy of photo identification, 5 were missing education verification, and 3 were missing a signed statement of overview for operation policies and personnel policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During an inspection, it was observed a caregiver left a classroom, leaving the children unattended, to grab something from another room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: During an inspection, 4 caregivers did not know how many children they were responsible for.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: During an investigation inspection, two classrooms were observed to be out of ratio. This was corrected when another went into each room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Parental Notification of Infestation: During an investigation, there was sufficient evidence to show there was not a written notice to parents when there was a lice outbreak.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Notification of Infestation (26 TAC §746.307(e))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: During an investigation, there was evidence to suggest a caregiver was present at the operation before receiving an eligible background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Pinch, Crush, or Shear Points: During the walkthrough, I observed that one slide was broken in the middle, and there were rocks inside.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Pinch, Crush, or Shear Points (26 TAC §746.4601(7))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: During a DFPS investigation operation staff were found to provide a parent of a child in care inaccurate information regarding an incident that occurred with their child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: During a DFPS investigation, it was determined operation staff did not notify CCR about a child left alone on the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During a DFPS investigation a child in care was observed to have been left alone on the playground for about 10 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: 1 staff did not have the required affidavit, background verification, CPR and First Aid, high school diploma. for review. A second staff did not have annual trainings.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Types of Vehicles Used to Transport Children - Be Maintained Safely: Three vehicles used for transportation was observed and does not have current registration stickers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Types of Vehicles Used to Transport Children - Be Maintained Safely (26 TAC §746.5603(c))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: There must not be any peeling paint or separation of border which can cause a hazard.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: 1 staff did not have the required affidavit, background verification, CPR and First Aid, high school diploma. for review. A second staff did not have annual trainings.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Determining Child/Caregiver Ratios - Basis: A caregiver was observed in the classroom with 6 children bringing the classroom out of ratio by 1. This was corrected when the caregiver returned to the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Determining Child/Caregiver Ratios - Basis (26 TAC §746.1507(1))

occurrences.finding: Types of Vehicles Used to Transport Children - Be Maintained Safely: The vehicles used for transportation did not have the required registration.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Types of Vehicles Used to Transport Children - Be Maintained Safely (26 TAC §746.5603(c))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: A caregiver was observed allowing a child to go to the bathroom unsupervised. The caregiver then left the classroom leaving the children unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - License: The parent board was missing the written activity plans for each age group, a list of the current employees, the emergency evacuation plan, and the most recent licensing inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - License (26 TAC §746.401(1))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: Two caregivers were observed on personal cell phones while caring for children. This was corrected during the inspection when the caregiver put the device away.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: An incident placing a child at risk was not reported to Child Care Regulation as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: It was found that one child gained access to the operation's outdoor playground by a propped open door.  The child was found to be left unsupervised for about 2-3 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For: One caregiver stated that they were responsible for 7 children.  There were 6 children observed in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For (26 TAC §746.1203(2))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: One plastic playground structure was observed to be in disrepair and cracks were covered with tape.  The director stated that the equipment would be removed and children would not use the equipment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: It was found that one caregiver did not have current transportation training and is frequently transporting children in the operation van.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: It was found during this investigation, that one child was left outside on the playground unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: It was found during the investigation that one child was present at the operation without enrollment information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Current Driver's License: One caregiver, responsible for transporting children, was unable to provide a current driver's license and there was not one on file.  The caregiver will not transport children until a valid driver's license is obtained.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Photo Identification (26 TAC §746.901(9))

occurrences.finding: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio: During the follow-up inspection it was observed that there were 37 children in a combined nap room with an average age of 3 years old. Nap ratio was over by 7 children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio (26 TAC §746.1613(b))

occurrences.finding: Reduction of child/caregiver naptime ratio by 50% allowed, If 13 or more children in care, children are 18 mo. or older and other standards met: During the monitoring inspection it was observed that the operation was reducing number of caregivers during naptime for children that were under 18 months old. There was a combined nap room with children ranging from 13 months to 2 years old in a 1 caregiver to 16 children ratio.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Reduction of child/caregiver naptime ratio by 50% allowed, If 13 or more children in care, children are 18 mo. or older and other standards met (26 TAC §746.1613(a))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions: During the monitoring inspection it was found that the vans used to transport were not equipped with working electronic child safety alarms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions (26 TAC §746.5625(b))
